title: Frequent-Expedite Discount for Home Delivery Pharmacy Members
content:
## Member terms: discount for frequent expedited shipping

**Term.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy expedited fee, a frequent-expedite discount is taken off the fee and its surcharges together: 25 percent when four or more expedited fees are booked on the account within the review window, 10 percent when two or three are, and none when fewer than two are.

The count is of the expedited shipping-fee charges booked on the account and dated within the review window on the handling date.

### Discount by count

| Expedited fees booked within the review window | Discount |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 25 percent |
| 2 or 3 | 10 percent |
| 0 or 1 | none |

### Boundaries

- 4 fees: 25 percent; 3 fees: 10 percent.
- 2 fees: 10 percent; 1 fee: none.

### How the discount acts (hypothetical figures)

The discount is one percentage taken once off the fee and its surcharges together. A fee of 22.95 with a surcharge of 8.00 is 30.95 together; with four fees in the window, 25 percent of 30.95 is taken off, leaving 23.2125 before the final rounding to the cent. With two fees in the window, 10 percent is taken off, leaving 27.855 before the final rounding.
